topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got this package, and it looks brand new. The address is right, but the name... it's not mine. I mean, I recognize the handwriting from when we first moved in; it’s clearly addressed to the person before us. I wonder what’s inside. Should I open it to see if it’s something important and then try to find the right person? Or is it better to leave it sealed and call the post office to see what they suggest? It feels like a tricky situation. I hope I handle it right.
